# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0001 (parent: seed, val 0.400). Reader at runtime is `aws/gpt-oss-120b` (mid tier),
so every fix the agent "knows but skips" is enforced in **tool code**, not prose. All edits
verified by running the real tool bodies against the live DB (`FlightDB.load(AIRLINE_DB_PATH)`)
on the EXACT failing-trace args AND the passing-task (12) args.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Payment amount/shape on book | 8, 25, (23 partial) | agent emits malformed payment dicts (`id` not `payment_id`, missing `amount`) and/or a split that doesn't sum to total → tool raises "payment_id Field required" / "does not add up"; also a split-brain bug where corrected amounts never reached the stored reservation | CAPABILITY-GAP / KNOWLEDGE | tools.py in-body normalize + auto-correct + stored-history re-sync |
| 2 | COMMUNICATE: exact $ not stated | 11, 17, 19, 37 | write tools returned a bare Reservation; agent never had an explicit "charged/refunded $X across all passengers" string, so COMMUNICATE checks for the amount flaked | KNOWLEDGE | tools.py enriched returns with `payment_summary`/`total_*` |
| 3 | Baggage free-allowance miscount | 22 | gold/economy agent set `nonfree=3` for 3 bags (allowance is 3/pax×2pax=6 → should be 0), then charged + supplied a wrong gift-card id → "Payment method not found", hard zero | KNOWLEDGE | tools.py deterministic free-allowance recompute + free-skip payment guard |
| 4 | Reservation id unknown | (modify/cancel class) | policy said "help locate it" but gave no concrete tool procedure | KNOWLEDGE | policy.md additive procedure |
| 5 | Double-confirm → USER_STOP before write | 8, 22, 25 (termination_reason USER_STOP) | agent re-confirms an already-authorized action; user simulator ###STOP###s before the write executes | BEHAVIORAL | policy.md additive "confirm once, then execute" |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | in-body normalize | tools.py book_reservation | accept `id`→`payment_id` and default missing `amount`; fires only when payment_id/amount absent, so a well-formed dict is untouched | yes — correct bookings skip it |
| 1 | in-body auto-correct | tools.py book_reservation | on sum≠total: single payment covers total; else single credit card absorbs remainder after fixed-value methods. Fires ONLY on mismatch (correct bookings have sum==total) | yes — no mismatch = skipped |
| 1 | DB-correctness fix | tools.py book_reservation | `reservation.payment_history` was deep-copied BEFORE auto-correct, so the graded DB kept the pre-correction amounts; re-sync after correcting | yes — only re-syncs on a mismatch |
| 2 | enriched return | tools.py book/cancel/update_flights/update_baggages | add `payment_summary` + `total_charged`/`total_refunded`/`price_difference` (already ×passengers). Return is NOT graded for DB, so cannot change DB reward; gives the agent the exact figure to COMMUNICATE | yes — return-only, DB unchanged |
| 3 | free-allowance recompute | tools.py update_reservation_baggages | recompute `nonfree_baggages = max(0, total − per_pax[tier][cabin]×n_pax)` from the policy table; pure domain arithmetic = gold value | yes — no-op on task 12 (0→0) |
| 3 | free-skip payment guard | tools.py update_reservation_baggages | only validate/charge a payment when `total_price>0`; a free update must not be rejected for a bad/unneeded payment id | yes — task 12 appended nothing before and after |
| 4 | additive procedure | policy.md | concrete lookup: `get_user_details`→`get_reservation_details` to find a reservation by route/date | yes — additive knowledge |
| 5 | additive rule | policy.md | confirm once per action, then make the tool call next turn; report the exact `payment_summary` amount | yes — task 12 already executes promptly |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the code now does on those exact inputs)
- 25 book `[gift 128, credit 171]` total 375 → auto-correct sets credit→247; STORED payment_history = [128, 247] (was the split-brain 171). Correct split `[128,247]` → no-op.
- 8 book lone certificate malformed `{'type','id'}` / amount 500 vs gold 322 → normalize to Payment, single-payment auto-correct sets amount→322; STORED = [certificate_8045380, 322]; validation passes.
- 22 baggages `UM3OG5` gold/economy/2pax total=3 nonfree=3 bad id `gift_card_8190033` → recompute nonfree→0, total_price→0, payment skipped, NO raise; STORED total=3 nonfree=0, no new payment.
- 12 (PASSING) baggages `YAX4DR` gold/economy/2pax total=2 nonfree=0 valid card → recompute 0→0 no-op, total_price 0, payment_history len 1→1 (unchanged). No regression.
- paid-bags safety: regular/economy/1pax total=3 (free=1) → recompute nonfree→2, charge $100 to credit card. Arithmetic intact.
- 11/19 update_flights/cancel → `payment_summary` states exact refund (e.g. $5244 / $169); return-only, DB untouched.
- import/registration: all 14 tools register; `REMOVE_TOOLS` empty.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel: serial — single-candidate task, tight verification loop against one DB; parallelism offered no benefit over direct `python` runs.
- Prior iterations read: none exist (this is iteration 1; RUNMAP/LEDGER show seed only).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The `payment_history` re-sync after auto-correct — without it the DB hash silently keeps pre-correction amounts (looks fixed in the return, fails the graded DB).
- The free-skip payment guard paired WITH the free-allowance recompute — together they make a within-allowance update immune to a wrong/unneeded payment id.
- Enriched returns are DB-neutral (return value is not hashed); keep them return-only.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- TitleCase kwargs (`Insurance`, `Payment Methods`) on book — tasks 8-t2, 23. Fixing needs `**kwargs`/schema change that widens the API surface and risks other tasks; the agent self-corrects on retry. Low value, high blast radius → skipped.
- Multi-certificate split mismatch (task 23: 871 vs 2613, 3 certificates) — no safe deterministic "which certificate absorbs the remainder" rule; auto-correcting would guess. Left to raise.
- Task 23 cancel-then-rebook wrong strategy and Task 40 passenger-name refusal — DECISION/strategy clusters. Per instructions, do NOT loosen a global decision/permission/refusal rule; no code-enforceable discriminating condition without overfitting → skipped.
